Chapter 6517: What Is This Magical Place?

Chapter 6517: What Is This Magical Place?

Li Qiye entered Heaven World but not any of the major heavens. He visited a mysterious realm beyond the reach of primal ancestors, hidden in an inconspicuous corner.

A frown appeared on entry due to the presence of power ripples. Ordinary emperors couldn’t get through. As for primal ancestors and heaven-slayers, they had to muster all of their power to break this barrier.

The first possessed a purifying affinity for the mind. After breaking the first, Li Qiye found a second.

He only took one step to make it through the first, the same for the second. However, it surprised him due to its origin.

“Who is it?” The second was numerous times stronger than the first and had an ancient presence.

It was old from the perspective of modern cultivators and emperors. However, in terms of the start of time, this ancient presence was cultivated, not formed naturally.

It formed a supreme momentum to protect the realm, becoming one with it. Li Qiye could still enter undetected, but its existence surprised him.

Creating this momentum required immense time and effort from a supreme overlord or higher.

He speculated this power was born at the same time as the realm, serving as the foundation. Other supreme overlords could detect the barrier but wouldn’t see the realm within.

“Right here.” While tracing the second, he noticed a third hidden power.

Supreme overlords couldn’t notice this one. It prevented them from getting through or realizing something else was within.

Another power was connected to this one, hidden in the deepest area of this world. It wasn’t here to protect like the previous three powers. Li Qiye smiled since he knew the item was here.

“Who created this realm?” The skull could still recognize the aura changes.

“Not quite create since only the high heaven can create a true world. Who else can do it?” Li Qiye smiled.

“You, him.” The skull answered and after sensing the third power, it asked: “I sense your presence, you created it.”

“I don’t have the ability.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Don’t think I don’t recognize your power here. I’m crippled, not stupid.” The skull said.

“It’s just a progenitor wanting a different life.” Li Qiye said.

“So you casually planted your power as well.” The skull said: “Not a savior but always saving, I see.”

“A savior has strict rules, I’m just a passerby who follows my heart.” Li Qiye said.

“Many view you as a savior.” The skull said.

“They can think what they want.” Li Qiye smiled.

“All talk, haha.” The skull laughed before becoming serious: “He was here.”

“Yes.” Li Qiye nodded.

“What is this magical place? You’re here, he was here.” The skull said.

Since the skull and that person had the same origin, the skull could sense this hidden affinity instantly.

“Just a minor realm.” Li Qiye said.

“So the thing is here?” The skull asked.

“Not sure. Someone else was here first but he did leave something.” Li Qiye shook his head.
